AI-Powered Design-to-Code Automation:
Impact:
Agentic AI for Multimodal PDF-to-HTML Update Automation:
Product Overview: Spearheaded data science efforts for an AI product that automates the conversion of PDF-basedemailers
and e-detail designs into responsive HTML. This tool eliminates manual HTML development, streamliningworkflows
, and improving productivity across design and development teams.
Content Extraction: Utilized Azure Document Intelligence/AWS Textract to accurately extract text, images, and itsmetadata
from PDFs, ensuring seamless design-to-code translation.
Custom Object Detection: Designed and deployed YOLO v10 models to identify key layout features, such as CTAs, lines,
and other design elements.
Generative AI Implementation: Engineered workflows using LLMs for automated HTML-to-MJML conversion.
Integrated advanced features like background gradient detection, CTA shape identification, and vertical text propertyextraction
Layout Structuring: Built custom algorithms to detect rows and column layouts, providing critical insights to front-endteams
for responsive HTML generation.
Improved content extraction accuracy for production-ready designs. Adopted by 8-10 enterprise clients, each with 5 or moredevelopers
, driving significant productivity gains across teams.
Integrated multimodal inputs (OCR, bounding box, HTML/CSS) to support structured transformations.
ICB (Intelligent Content Brain)
Impact:
Project Overview: Developed an AI-powered tool that processes PDFs (e.g., emailers, e-details) to extract and analyzecontent
intelligently, using advanced vision and NLP techniques. This platform provides intelligent content analysis andactionable
insights for end clients.
Key Message Tagging: Fine-tuned a multi-class classification model using BERT to identify and tag critical key messages,
enhancing automated content analysis.
Image/Text Semantic Modeling: Implemented transfer learning to build a robust image/text similarity model.
Multilingual NER Model: Utilized SpaCy and Hugging Face frameworks to extract NER in 12+ languages, expanding thetool
's global applicability for a diverse clientele.
MLOps Implementation: Designed a comprehensive data science pipeline with data collection, model retraining, andmodel
deployment, leveraging AWS and
MLFlow for iterative model updates based on feedback loops.
